PubMed.export_format: PubMed XML or NBIB with exact query history

Web of Science.export_format: Full Record and Cited References in plain text or RIS

PsycINFO.platform: APA PsycINFO provider must be confirmed before execution
PsycINFO.export_format: RIS with provider, query history, thesaurus terms and filters

CNKI.export_format: Refworks/RIS or EndNote export plus search screenshot/log

eligibility.date_range: database inception to actual search date
eligibility.population: adolescents or studies with separately extractable adolescent results
include: at least two focal constructs for direct empirical evidence
longitudinal, prospective, cross-lagged or RI-CLPM evidence for dynamic claims
measurement or method evidence assigned to a predefined evidence slot
Chinese or English records with verifiable metadata
exclude: adult-only results that cannot be separated
suicidal behavior and NSSI not distinguishable for a claim specifically about NSSI
exclusion based on significance or direction of findings

quality_assurance.deduplication: DOI, PMID, OpenAlex ID, then normalized title plus first author plus year; retain immutable source exports
quality_assurance.screening: two independent reviewers with third-reviewer adjudication; pilot calibration before formal screening
quality_assurance.retraction_check: verify correction, expression-of-concern and retraction status before an item satisfies a core slot
quality_assurance.supplemental_search: backward and forward citation chasing from seed and included studies; refresh within 30 days before submission
